description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B for code generation, review and fixes. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/coder and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $1.98 per million input and $3 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0173. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (streaming supported), up to 2048 output tokens. Costs $0.0173 USDC per call (x402).
